name: rp1-feed-footer
js: (async () => { const w=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const feed=[...document.querySelectorAll('.roomtabs button')].find(b=>(b.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')==='Feed'); if(feed) feed.click(); await w(1400); const hb=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/history/i.test(b.getAttribute('aria-label')||b.getAttribute('title')||'')); if(hb) hb.click(); await w(700); const f=document.querySelector('.replyfoot'); if(f) f.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); await w(500); })()

name: rp4-composer-pill
js: (async () => { const w=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const feed=[...document.querySelectorAll('.roomtabs button')].find(b=>(b.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')==='Feed'); if(feed) feed.click(); await w(1400); const hb=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/history/i.test(b.getAttribute('aria-label')||b.getAttribute('title')||'')); if(hb) hb.click(); await w(700); const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.msg')].find(x=>(x.textContent||'').includes('traps focus on iPad')); if(m){ m.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover',{bubbles:true})); await w(250); const b=m.querySelector('.msgactions button'); if(b) b.click(); } await w(900); const c=document.querySelector('.rpill'); if(c) c.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); await w(300); })()
